### TL;DR:

Infinity simplifies banking for global businesses. It enables cross-border Indian companies to conduct transactions and receive payments in local currencies. Additionally, Infinity offers an in-house treasury management solution, allowing businesses to earn yield on idle cash and mitigate FX risks.

Hey everyone! We’re [Sourav](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sourav-choraria-9b389776/) and [Sidharth](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sidharth-choraria-25411b65/) and we're building a business banking platform for cross-border SMBs and Startups. In our past jobs, we worked as founders, wealth managers, growth hackers, and founding engineers at high-growth fintech startups.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78490&key=user_uploads/1347097/151b89e9-ff7d-4da8-8fd1-758c5bc04cac)

### 

### 🤔 Problem

Business banking is difficult. More so if you are global. Cross-border payments pose several challenges due to the complexities involved in transferring funds across different countries and jurisdictions.\
\
**Global payments are expensive**\
One of the more basic issues with FX transactions is the lack of transparency in terms of the cost to execute FX payments. These costs can include wire transfer fees, correspondent bank fees, currency conversion fees, and intermediary fees, among others. While existing market providers might stress that one factor is low (lower than that of a competitor), that same institution might have high fees in another area, offsetting those savings.

_In general for every dollar a business moves from the US to India, business loses **7%.**_

**Global payments are slow**\
In the majority of instances, international bank transfers are facilitated via the SWIFT network. This network ensures the transmission of your payment to its intended recipient. Nevertheless, the path isn't always direct. Certain payments may be routed through intermediaries, often referred to as correspondent banks, akin to making multiple connecting flights before reaching your final destination.

_Generally speaking, international bank transfers will arrive within **one to five working days**._

**There’s a compliance risk** \
Each transaction must be promptly reported to the Central Bank of India, accompanied by the correct invoice and purpose codes (of which there are numerous variations), sign-off from chartered accountants, etc. Failure to comply with these requirements can result in payment delays extending for months.

**And There’s a FX risk**\
The conversion rates between USD and INR are variable.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78490&key=user_uploads/224267/144ca69a-c117-4837-b4ae-731cfed5fc15)

What you receive today may differ from what you get in five days. If a business converts USD to INR five days from now and the dollar weakens, it will incur losses.

### 🤩 The Solution

Introducing Infinity!\
Streamline global customers and suppliers’ payments with local accounts.

**1) Multiple local currency accounts - one platform:** Easily send, hold, and receive funds in major currencies to facilitate transactions with overseas suppliers and customers.\
**2) Flat Fee - with zero FX markup:** Be fully transparent about the charges you incur. Receive a comprehensive breakdown of fees before each transaction to avoid any surprises.\
**3) Fast, same-day international money transfer:** Track your payment in real time.\
**4)** **Treasury service to hedge FX:** Earn higher yields on idle cash without worrying about liquidity and underlying asset risk.\
**5) Instant remittance certificate:** You move money. Infinity will take care of compliance.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78490&key=user_uploads/224267/aa9f08af-a85a-4252-b889-f62c1e2a2d6a)

\
Our long-term vision is to be the **_financial operating system_** for businesses by automating daily financial tasks, allowing them to focus on what matters most.

launches.tagline: AI-powered contract and remittance analytics to detect insurance underpayments.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** [Fuse](https://fuseinsight.com/) offers AI-powered analysis of healthcare contracts and payments to help providers detect underpayments and collect the revenue they’re owed from insurers.

# **❌ Problem**

Our “aha” moment came when healthcare provider execs repeatedly told us they had no idea if their revenue was accurate. One even described their insurance claims process as a “black hole”. 

Several factors contribute to this issue: 

1. Growing usage of AI. Insurers are using sophisticated models to analyze claims and find ways to subtly underpay.
2. Too many contracts: An average hospital has over 50 contracts with insurers with varying reimbursement rates for the same procedure, making payment accuracy verification costly and near impossible.
3. M&A wave: Mergers are forcing providers to consolidate contracts and revenue tracking systems, adding further complexity.

As a result, providers spend months analyzing revenue and chasing payments, forfeiting up to 11% of topline revenue if they cannot afford the overhead to do so.

With provider operating margins already negative since COVID-19, the situation creates severe margin compression and cash flow risk.

# **Solution**

We use LLMs to extract data from the stacks of contracts that dictate provider payment terms from insurers. We reconcile the data against remittances to identify underpayments and auto-generate appeals.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83233&key=user_uploads/1507819/169bfbcd-d6cd-41ba-86d1-f63d06334f04)

Our mission is to level the playing field for providers with AI-powered contract analytics. Beyond this, we want to aid the transition towards Value-Based Care by powering sophisticated contract modeling as payment models become even more complex.

# **Team**

Our team specializes in complex financial data analytics. We previously co-founded a business that grew from $0 to $6M ARR in 12 months, developing large-scale data models for payment and credit analytics that outperformed major players like Experian.

launches.body:
# Numo is like upside-down Deel

# TL;DR

[Numo](https://numohq.com/) verifies and credentials global contractors and lets them earn and hold the USD they get from working for American companies. When they need to spend it, we transfer money instantly to their local bank account.

**We launched last week, and have 105 contractors already live and onboarded on Numo, sending their first invoices.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79553&key=user_uploads/1452570/4a2d0978-bdb1-42d8-a223-5c8554db82a9)

# Problem

**Paying international contractors for short-term engagements is messy**. It’s full of remittance services whose brands are not conducive to trust or a professional environment and often look fraudulent to the uninformed. \
\
**For contractors, it’s even messier**. With expensive fees, slow transfer times, and fuzzy tax + compliance rules — we’ve seen our customers resort to funneling money through friends and families just to get paid. \
\
And the death blow for contractors is the hyperinflation many of their home currencies are experiencing. **Contractors work more every day for less money**. International contractors want to hold their funds in USD as long as they can, and then bring it back only when they need to spend.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79553&key=user_uploads/1452570/dd9fa8fc-a5f6-4452-840c-983c916dc798)

# Solution

So we built Numo:

1. Contractors can onboard and get verified, background checked, and launch their profiles.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79553&key=user_uploads/1452570/c7a8c8c3-c8e5-43b2-bb63-ca263a11ddbd)

2. Every invoice they send via Numo to their clients is paired with their verified profile.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79553&key=user_uploads/1452570/ac16cb72-92bc-4a04-b8ed-fe2d6201e7b2)

3. Their American clients get to pay the way they are most comfortable: ACH payment to a US bank account.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79553&key=user_uploads/1452570/a6370253-5288-4585-bc8d-545bacda9e58)

4. Contractors can hold the USD they make stateside until the moment they need to spend it locally. They can transfer funds to their local account within 20 seconds without excessive fees.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79553&key=user_uploads/1452570/224d13fc-c6ef-423f-8750-437d738673b6)

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79553&key=user_uploads/1452570/de06e012-08e5-4ac3-8728-4c67339ae615)


# We’re the team to build this

We all met working in the messy, terrible world of global telecom. We were the early operators at Hologram — a worldwide cellular network for IoT — taking the business from $0 to $20M ARR and through a successful Series B round.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79553&key=user_uploads/1452570/f8cd963f-353b-4bc5-8994-aaca6f3f0b83)

_👆 The Numo team on the ground running onboarding events in Lagos, Nigeria._

[Reuben Balik](https://www.linkedin.com/in/reuben-balik/) was the first engineer at Hologram. He led the integrations with some of the worst telco APIs from Verizon, Telus, Deutsche Telekom, and TIS into a unified SIM card platform.

[Q Carlson](https://www.linkedin.com/in/qcarlson/) was the 2nd designer at Flexport and has crafted beautiful experiences in messy, hard industries like supply chain. He uses design to differentiate — attracting a premium for the product and accelerating growth.

[Derrick Wolbert](https://www.linkedin.com/in/derrickwolbert/) ran the GTM team at Hologram from zero through Series B. Before Hologram, he navigated complex bureaucracy at Jeep/Chrysler, building the infotainment platform Waymo relies on in their vehicles.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=79553&key=user_uploads/1452570/b005abd6-ee98-4c73-b11d-cb69a5067edb)

_Numo founders in Dogpatch 👆_

launches.tagline: An AI CFO that pays your bills, collects your invoices, and forecasts your cash.
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Blaze is an agent that runs the entire finance function for your business: pay bills, accept payments, forecast your cash flow, and keep your books current. Install it with **npx @blaze-money/cli**. Use it with your favorite agentic harness or at blaze.money/agentic-finance. ChatGPT, Claude apps, and OpenClaw plugin coming soon.\
\
Our launch video: <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ulOQ2cVK9Ds>

## ❌ The problem

You're a lean team busy doing more than you can handle already, and finances feel like a perpetual weight on your shoulders. You know there are bills to pay, invoices to collect on, questions you want answered. But a real finance team costs $10,000 to $20,000 a month, and you could always "do it yourself," so the problem goes on dangling, half solved, half annoyance, always taking up RAM.

What ends up happening is bills get paid late, you spend money on some $300/month marketing software your interns bought months ago without you knowing, and real problems with your vendors, payroll, and runway sneak up on you at 2am on Sunday.

We've lived this personally. As a 3 year old, super lean fintech team running all our own finances, we know what it's like trying to keep the finances afloat while doing everything else it takes to make it big. It's not like the work is rocket science. It's just constant, manual, nagging, and spread across 18 different tools that need sense making.

Until recently, you had to pay $10,000 a month to hire a finance function. We'd like to change that.

## 🛠 What we built

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=108616&key=user_uploads/85958/4ef6fa06-6115-4df5-bacf-cc481a437e15)

\
Chat with Blaze from your favorite agentic harness and watch it get real things done for your finances:

* **Pay bills and contractors.** Tell it to pay the AWS bill and it finds the invoice, shows you the amount, and pays on your approval. "Send Maria $3,000 for the design work" works the same way, domestic or international.
* **Collect payments and send invoices.** "Send Acme a payment link for $12,500." Blaze creates the link, sends it, and updates you when it's paid. Draft a real invoice the same way, from a one-line request. If a client drags their feet, it follows up automatically.
* **Forecast cash.** Connects to your bank through Plaid, finds the recurring patterns, and projects your balance so you know your runway.
* **Handle the pre-accounting.** Categorizes transactions and matches them to the bills and invoices they belong to as they happen, so your actual accounting is easier when you get to it.
* **Move stablecoins.** On and off-ramps USDC across 80+ currencies, with support for cards and various local payment methods around the world.
* **Flag problems early.** Tells you about a low balance, an overdue invoice, or unusual spend before it becomes an issue.

It installs with one command:

```
npx @blaze-money/cli
```

You can use it anywhere you use AI agents. Our favorites are in Hermes on Telegram and on the dashboard at dashboard.blaze.money. There's a REST API and SDK if you want to connect it to your own systems.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=108616&key=user_uploads/85958/492a039d-5aeb-4cab-bc85-33fe8f82f1c0)

## 🙏 Ask

If you are, or you know, any of the following, we'd love to hear from you.

**Founders running lean**

You're doing your own bills, invoicing, and cash flow because a real finance team costs $10,000 to $20,000 a month. Try it and tell us what breaks: **npx @blaze-money/cli** or <https://blaze.money/agentic-finance>.

**Early customers**

We're onboarding our first businesses now, and want people who'll help us decide what the agent should handle next. Especially focused on handyman and trades businesses (HVAC, repair, remodeling) and property managers, especially in the Airbnb space.

**Anyone with an intro**

To founders and small teams who'd rather not open their bank again. You can reach us at [founders@blaze.money](mailto:founders@blaze.money).

## 👥 Team

Faiyam is a full-stack engineer who dropped out of med school to build startups instead. As a founding engineer at Luc's previous startup, he helped it scale to $1m in ARR. He manages finances for Blaze, and is personally relieved he no longer needs to stay up on Sunday nights to do so.

Luc is a two-time founder. His first startup hit #1 on the App Store. Before that, he was a tech lead at Spotify and Artsy. Luc built Blaze's cross-border payment rails after living the problem firsthand, moving money in and out of Latin America.

Fun fact: Luc and Faiyam met after Faiyam "coincidentally" sat down next to him at a coffee shop in Williamsburg, New York, seven years ago. The rest is history (in the making).

[Infinite](https://youtu.be/L0Zho4tT8w8)

#### **TL;DR: Fast-track your stablecoin integration**

Infinite makes it easy for developers to embed global stablecoin payment rails through a turnkey SDK. Our customers use us to move money cross-border on same-day with low fees, all without crypto complexity.

#### **The problem**

After talking to over hundreds of merchants and payment processors, we found that global payments are slow, expensive, and unreliable. Traditional financial rails such as SWIFT result in high fees and multi-day delays with little transparency on the state of their transfer. Yet companies, both big and small, struggle to adopt stablecoins due to complex compliance requirements and fragmented vendor integrations.

#### **Our solution**

We're building what merchants worldwide need: fast, affordable global payment rails that can be integrated in days instead of months. Infinite can process same-day payments to over 170 countries, enabling businesses to leverage stablecoins as a settlement network (a la SWIFT) for cross-border payments. Our network of on and off-ramps provides connectivity to local fiat funding and payout flows, enabling faster global money movement and our turnkey SDKs and APIs allow businesses to embed stablecoins into their applications faster. Today, our platform supports:

* **Customer Bank to User Bank** — US bank -> International bank (e.g., USA to LATAM), allowing businesses to send local currency payments with instant settlement to LATAM, Europe, Africa, and SEA
* **Customer Bank to User Wallet** — US bank -> user wallet, allowing businesses to send USD stablecoin payouts globally and instantly
* **Customer Bank to User SDK** — Embedded wallet and hosted links experience for payment beneficiaries to seamlessly receive and manage stablecoin payments without dealing with crypto complexity
* **Treasury Management** — Store balances in USD-denominated stablecoins earn a competitive yield and issue cards against wallet balances

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=88276&key=user_uploads/39977/7323ca79-3e4d-4e27-8a2d-7417c40b06c4)

We partner with early-stage to mid-market companies with global payments, contractor payouts, and treasury management workflows, including:

* **Creator Economy** – Creator payouts for platforms looking to reduce payment costs, increase successful delivery rates to their global creator base, and offer USD-based payout options
* **Global Payroll** – Global payroll platforms looking to increase coverage, streamline tax compliance, and move money faster.
* **Logistics** – Import/export payments for businesses struggling with slow settlement times and high fees in cross-border trade

* **Neobanks:** Traditional banks for SMBs or neobanks in emerging markets looking to hold stablecoin-backed treasuries and remit globally

We’re building this platform to solve pain points we experienced building financial products at scale at companies like [Sardine](https://sardine.ai) and [Coinbase,](https://coinbase.com) where we learned about customers’ needs firsthand.

### **TL;DR**

BlindPay is a stablecoin API that helps companies navigate LatAm's complex financial regulations while enabling fast and affordable global payments. Watch our demo [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=N9hHISlGp9Y).

### **The Problem**

Businesses face significant hurdles when sending and receiving global payments:

* Traditional methods rely on correspondent banks, adding fees (1.5-6% for B2B) and delays of 2-5 business days or more. Bank transfers typically require 2-4 intermediaries between smaller countries, with costs reaching hundreds of dollars. 
* Frequent fluctuations in Latin American currencies, coupled with extreme inflation rates (over 50% annually in some countries), make international payments unpredictable and risky. 
* Complex regulations and strict compliance rules across jurisdictions require different documentation for each institution. 
* Fragmented payment landscapes across countries require integration with multiple local payment systems (like SPEI, Pix, PSE), making implementation resource-intensive

### **Our Solution**

Our API integrates seamlessly with your existing workflows. With BlindPay you can:

* Send and receive payments using fiat money and stablecoins
* Get competitive FX quotes and low transaction fees
* Connect directly to local instant payment systems across Latin America
* 24/7 payments with instant settlement
* Ensure compliance through blockchain screening, tiered KYC/KYB levels, and continuous transaction monitoring

Expand your global reach while reducing costs and transaction times by up to 80%. Powered by stablecoins and blockchain, our platform eliminates the delays, high fees, and regulatory barriers of traditional payment systems.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87070&key=user_uploads/2098545/f81c874e-a8e7-4a92-ab1e-de8897529a63)

* Direct integration with local payment systems like SPEI (Mexico), Pix (Brazil), PSE (Colombia) and Transfers (Argentina)

* Real-time payment tracking and transaction monitoring

launches.title: Grade: Performance based Payroll
launches.tagline: Helping companies pay their workers based on performance.
launches.body:
**Lotanna** and **James** here, co-founders at Grade (YC W26).

Grade is performance based payroll. We help companies pay workers based on results.

### 

### **Our Launch Video 🎥**

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wbNeaDNaQKY>

### **The Problem ❌**

Payroll is huge. About $50T a year goes to worker pay worldwide. But most payroll systems still pay people for hours worked, even when hours do not match real output.

When companies try to pay on performance, it gets messy fast:

* The rules live in spreadsheets
* Approvals are manual
* Payouts are slow and mistakes happen

### **Our Unique Insight 💡**

Before Grade, we built, scaled, and exited 4 mobile AI apps. Creators were our main growth channel, and they helped us reach millions of users.

Paying creators was always a gamble. We paid a flat fee up front and hoped a video went viral. When we switched to paying for views instead, scaling got easy, but the tools were still spreadsheets. There was no payroll system for performance pay.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97852&key=user_uploads/1159814/0f8e12e4-c2c3-4a41-ad24-ff24b323d164)

### **The Solution ✅**

Grade makes performance pay run like real payroll, starting with creators.

* Pay creators any way you want (flat fees, performance pay, bonused)
* We track performance and calculate payouts automatically
* Approve and pay out in bulk, we deal with all the invoices and tax complaince

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97852&key=user_uploads/1159814/58ba3703-1ad5-40d8-9416-24b28145fa41)

### **Traction 📊**

In the last 30 days, companies used Grade to **pay out $380k+** to creators, up 120% MoM

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97852&key=user_uploads/1159814/07111969-8895-4c5e-99f2-d8e6606424d5)

### **Our ask 📣**

If your company is paying creators at scale and you want pay tied to results without the spreadsheet mess, we would love to talk.

[usegrade.com](http://usegrade.com)
